concerns.text: FR-002, FR-002b, and US-1 require computing atomic radius, electronegativity, VEC, and pairwise descriptors, and saving the result to `data/processed/features.csv`. T014 (feature computation) and T017 (saving output) are marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). T016 (unknown element exclusion) is also `[ ]`. Without these tasks being actionable, the core data pipeline for US-1 cannot be satisfied.

FR-003, FR-004, FR-010, FR-011, FR-012, and US-2 require LOCO CV, model selection, heteroscedasticity handling, and SHAP generation. Tasks T021 (LOCO), T021b (PCA), T022 (selection), T023 (Breusch-Pagan), T024 (weighted retrain), T025 (SHAP), and T026 (SHAP output) are all marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). This blocks the entire Model Training and Validation phase.

FR-005 through FR-013 and US-3 require ternary generation, prediction, DoA, filtering, novelty checks, and ranking. Tasks T030 (generation), T031 (prediction), T032a (DoA), T033 (penalty), T034 (filtering), T035 (bootstrapping), T036 (novelty), T037 (ranking), T038 (candidates.csv), T039 (verification.json), and T040 (edge case) are all marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). The entire screening pipeline is missing implementation tasks.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and V (Versioning) require a specific directory structure and linting. T001 (directory structure), T003 (linting), and T004a (data directories) are marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). The foundational environment setup is incomplete.

US-3 requires independent testing. T028 (contract test) and T029 (integration test) are marked `[ ]` (unimplemented), leaving the screening phase without the required test coverage defined in the user story.

T008c is marked `[X]` (complete) but describes implementing `code/utils/novelty.py` to query external databases. However, T036 (the actual usage of this logic) is marked `[ ]` and relies on a local file fallback. The task description in T008c implies a complex external query implementation that is not reflected in the downstream task T036's logic (which defaults to a local file). This suggests a mismatch in the implementation plan for the novelty check, potentially leaving the 'querying' requirement of FR-013 unfulfilled if the external query logic was never actually implemented as described.
